title: Data
hint: Your words and progress are stored in this browser. Sign in on your profile to have them on all your devices.
resetConfirmText: Decks, progress and settings in this browser will be deleted. You will go through the initial setup again.
resetConfirmLinked: Decks, progress and settings in this browser will be deleted and you will be signed out. The copy on the server stays: sign in again to get your data back.
deviceText: Your words, decks, answers and settings are stored in this browser.
serverOut: You are not signed in: nothing of your words or progress is on the server.
serverIn: You are signed in: words, progress, settings and your league place sync with the server.
remindersText: For reminders the server knows only this browser’s push address and the time of the next reminder: no words, no name.
analyticsNever: We never collect your name, e-mail, IP address or the words themselves. More:
downloadNoServer: The file was saved without the server’s data: it could not be fetched. Try again.
downloadFailed: Could not build the file. Try again.
